name: lamp-effect
blurb: CSS-animated overhead lamp with expanding conic gradients and light rays.
description: Full-screen container with CSS-animated conic gradients creating a glowing lamp effect. Delay and duration customizable per animation.
use_when: A striking full-screen hero background with animated lamp illumination.
avoid_when: Limited viewport height — component requires min-h-screen for proper proportions.
a11y: Full-screen wrapper with content slot (z-50); focus and keyboard behaviour come from children.
